objective: Screen a hybrid that forces every recurrent RWKV update in a native write episode into the slot selected by the projected memory address.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: The corrected trainable MoE made donor-minus-correct CE positive by 0.002533 but left layer-permuted-minus-correct CE negative by 0.000107.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Move identity binding from the readout controller into the recurrent write address instead of adding another readout gate.

architecture.write_binding: The projected-KV proposal selects one slot; every valid RWKV token update from that write episode is recurrently scanned into the same one-hot slot.
architecture.read_addressing: The projected query route selects the corresponding recurrent slot.
architecture.fusion_equation: projected_read * (1 + 0.03125 * direction) + 0.0078125 * projected_rms * direction, where direction = tanh(addressed_recurrent_read / recurrent_rms)
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: A zero recurrent state produces zero direction, so fusion is exactly projected-only.
architecture.projected_carrier: Projected keys and values remain the fixed material carrier under recurrent interventions.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked supervised causal training run with a fresh source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and redesign the write binding.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, the unused strength holdout, or native generation.
